identity.name: 月兔地图师 / Moon Rabbit Mapmaker
identity.description: An original moon-rabbit cartographer who maps complex journeys into calm, approachable visual stories.

appearance.description: A gentle rabbit character with ivory-white fur, long ears, a crescent-shaped forelock, a midnight-blue short jacket, a mustard-yellow map satchel, a brass moon-phase compass, and a rolled star map.
